title: Pushforward of abelian sheaves along a closed immersion is exact
statement: Let X be a topological space [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology], let Z be a closed subset, and let i:Z\to X be the inclusion. For an abelian sheaf F on Z [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] define (i_*F)(U)=F(U\cap Z) for every open U of X. Then i_*:Ab(Z)\to Ab(X) preserves short exact sequences of abelian sheaves [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology].

proof.text: Take a short exact sequence $0\to F'\to F\to F''\to0$ in $\operatorname{Ab}(Z)$. The direct images form a sequence of abelian sheaves on $X$. By [lem-sc-closed-pushforward-abelian-stalks], at every $z\in Z$ their stalk sequence identifies naturally, including its two maps, with $0\to F'_z\to F_z\to F''_z\to0$.

proof.text: At every $x\in X\setminus Z$, [lem-sc-closed-pushforward-abelian-stalks] identifies all three direct-image stalks with zero, so the stalk sequence is $0\to0\to0\to0\to0$. At $z\in Z$, the sequence from Step 1 is short exact because the given sequence is short exact and short exactness is detected on stalks by [lem-sc-abelian-sheaf-short-exact-stalkwise], now applied on $Z$.

source.place: Lemma 01AX (modules-lemma-i-star-exact), proof: Sheaves Lemma 00AE and Modules Lemma 01AG

proof.text: Every stalk sequence of $0\to i_*F'\to i_*F\to i_*F''\to0$ is short exact by Step 2. Apply [lem-sc-abelian-sheaf-short-exact-stalkwise] on $X$ to conclude that this is a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves. Since the original sequence was arbitrary, $i_*$ preserves short exact sequences.
